remarks:
Historic character blends with thoughtful designer renovations in this Great Valley farmhouse charmer.  Nestled minutes away from the hustle and bustle of Ellicottville, the location offers the best of both town and country living

Built in 1890 as the former Great Valley Post Office, this building has unfolded over time and is ready for its next chapter after 35 years of stewardship by the current owners.  The spacious main floor layout offers great flow including multiple areas for entertainment and dining room with beautiful raised salt box ceiling, along with two ground floor bedrooms and 2-1/2 baths.  Another generously sized bedroom and bonus room await on the upper level. The square footage noted in this listing reflects measurements taken by  the listing agent and vary from that noted in the County records.

A covered rear porch overlooks bucolic land and neighboring pastures.  Enjoy outdoor entertaining at its best. Fabulous mature trees and gardens surround the back yard creating a relaxing atmosphere near a cozy firepit area.  Whisper quiet evenings and stargazing all four seasons long.  The property includes a separate barn built by local Bob McCarthy and awaits your passions, studio, workshop, yoga space...endless options.  Also a useful 10 x 10 storage shed on property.  You can have it all in this beautiful location.
